name: The Glass Solarium
tagline: Every secret leaves a reflection.
synopsis: When an eccentric patriarch vanishes during a family gathering, an investigator must interrogate eight scheming heirs. As motives multiply, a hidden clause in the family trust threatens to destroy them all.

name: Cipher of the Void
tagline: To survive their arrival, we must learn to listen.
synopsis: Twelve monolithic vessels enter orbit without transmission. A cryptographer races against military panic to translate alien glyphs before global nervous tensions ignite worldwide conflict.

name: The Velvet Chalet
tagline: High society manners, lowbrow subterranean schemes.
synopsis: A meticulous concierge and a resourceful bellhop become fugitive partners when an antique timepiece disappears. Pursued across snow-covered borders, they must outsmart rival inspectors to clear their names.

name: Chroma Shift
tagline: One spark ignites a million dimensions.
synopsis: A graffiti artist in a neon-lit metropolis unlocks the power to bend light between parallel timelines. When a reality rift threatens to collapse the sectors, he must unite disparate anomalies to seal the core.

name: Fractured Continuum
tagline: Infinite lives. One broken family to save.
synopsis: An overwhelmed laundromat proprietor discovers every choice she ever made created a parallel life. Hunted by a nihilistic force from across the timeline, she must harness past versions of herself to heal her family.

name: Cadence of Brass
tagline: Greatness demands everything you have left.
synopsis: A relentless conservatory percussionist seeks absolute perfection under an unyielding maestro. As rehearsals turn punishing and rivalry deepens, he risks his sanity for a single flawless performance.

name: The Whispering Lantern
tagline: Step past the gate before twilight fades.
synopsis: Trapped in an ancient spirit market after nightfall, a young wanderer must work in a mystical bathhouse to earn her freedom. Navigating fickle deities and forgotten memories, she searches for the way home.

name: Bramblewood
tagline: Wild instincts never stay buried for long.
synopsis: A retired animal rogue returns for one final raid against industrial farm owners surrounding his meadow. When retaliation traps his underground community, he leads a desperate escape through forgotten tunnels.

name: Stillness Falls
tagline: The loudest sound you make will be your last.
synopsis: In an abandoned valley stalked by sound-seeking nocturnal predators, a mother guards her homestead in absolute silence. When an unexpected storm damages their alarms, the family must flee without uttering a whisper.

name: The Hollow Estate
tagline: A polite smile can hide the darkest trap.
synopsis: A young photographer spends the weekend at his partner's secluded family manor, only to notice chilling behavioral anomalies among the staff. As hospitality shifts into psychological control, he uncovers a horrifying trade.

name: Desert Solstice
tagline: Tomorrow is today until they change the rhythm.
synopsis: Two cynical guests at an isolated desert retreat discover they are looping through the exact same wedding celebration. Faced with eternal repetition, they must confront their deepest fears to escape the temporal trap.

name: The Golden Marigold
tagline: Songs remember what the living forget.
synopsis: Forbidden from studying melody by his shoemaker ancestors, a boy slips into the illuminated world of spirits during a harvest festival. Guided by a trickster specter, he must prove his musical gift before sunrise.

name: Beyond the Event Horizon
tagline: Love is the one gravity across all worlds.
synopsis: As solar dust storms render terrestrial farming impossible, an engineer leaves his children to navigate an unmapped cosmic rift. Searching for habitable exoplanets, the crew confronts time distortion and isolation.

name: Subterranean Echoes
tagline: Two families living under one slanted roof.
synopsis: Living in a damp basement apartment, a cunning family infiltrates the staff of a modernist hillside villa. When an unexpected discovery reveals hidden occupants, the delicate illusion turns into a desperate struggle.

name: The Kensington Carousel
tagline: Kindness solves what cold hearts cannot.
synopsis: A small immigrant bear living in a London neighborhood works odd jobs to buy a rare antique book for his grandmother. Framed for its theft by an egocentric actor, he must inspire his fellow inmates to clear his name.

name: Apex Velocity
tagline: Speed is nothing without the nerve to pull up.
synopsis: An aging naval test aviator is ordered to train an elite echelon of young aviators for an impossible canyon strike. Facing lethal terrain and cockpit tensions, he must prove instinct still outflies automated drones.

name: Parallel Meridians
tagline: Two paths diverged. One question remains.
synopsis: Childhood friends separated by continental migration reconnect across two decades in modern Manhattan. Over three poignant days, they explore the roads not taken and the quiet weight of destiny.

name: Harbor Song
tagline: Her voice belongs to the sea, and to the world.
synopsis: As the only hearing member of a family fishing crew in Massachusetts, a high school singer acts as their vital link to buyers. When accepted to a prestigious music academy, she must choose between family duty and her art.

name: The Ridge Runners
tagline: Wanted by the law, united by the bush.
synopsis: A rebellious foster kid and his taciturn guardian get stranded in the remote southern highlands after a misunderstanding. As a sensationalized manhunt gathers, the unlikely duo survives off the land and becomes folk legends.

name: Sands of Aldebaran
tagline: Destiny is forged in the furnace of the desert.
synopsis: An exiled noble heir rallies the fierce nomadic tribes of an arid mineral planet to strike against imperial colonizers. Caught between vengeance and terrifying prophetic visions, he must choose the fate of his people.
